message: Ready to pay today for T45 with loader at $46,500.

Thanks for the offer, and glad you're ready to move today. Our prices are fixed at list, so I can't do $46,500. The T45 Utility with the front loader comes to $48,500 ($42,000 + $6,500). The offer below is at that price and you can pay at checkout. If you also want delivery and setup ($900) or the 3-year extended warranty ($2,400), I can add either one.
